scheme_name: Assistance for Power Driven Chaff Cutter Scheme under Integrated Fodder Development Scheme (General Category)
other_conditions: Beneficiary must own at least five animals of his/her own.
Purchase must be from a government‑approved empanelled vendor and the bill must be produced for subsidy claim.
Eligibility category noted in source: General Caste
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to 75% of the purchase cost or ₹18,000, whichever is lower, is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
